name: Read Source File
description: Reads a source file and produces file:source shape. Fundamental building block for composition.

tasks.description: Read file contents and produce file:source shape

prompt.template:
Read the file at {{file_path}} and output its contents.

Produce a JSON object with this structure:
{
  "shape": "file:source",
  "path": "<file path>",
  "content": "<file contents>",
  "language": "<detected language>",
  "lineCount": <number of lines>
}

Save to outputs/file-source.json
